name: Buddy's River Resort
note: Mostly seasonal: the whole riverbank row is seasonal, and about 60 of its roughly 150 sites, all inland, are sold by the night. The online booking link on its rates page (RVSpots) returned 404 in October 2026 while the park was closed for the season, so book by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site buddysriverresort.com (home, rates, registration/FAQ, map pages read 2026-10-21; same rates in the Wayback capture of 2026-06-10): nightly RV sites with water/electric 30A (limited 50A) or full hookups at a posted weekday rate, one camping unit per site, reservations online or by phone, no application, lease or membership for nightly stays; operator site map marks 29 W/E/S and 34 W/E sites against ~85 seasonal (about 42% nightly), no homes or lots for sale; Google Maps listing at the pin (read 2026-10-21) open, phone 608-644-6390, 4.5 stars from 117 reviews; Esri satellite (read 2026-10-21) shows gravel loops of travel trailers and motorhomes on 9-12 m pads -> real transient RV campground with a seasonal riverfront row, open May-Oct (reopens May 1 2027); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Operator site map (buddysriverresort.com/map, read 2026-10-21): every site along the Wisconsin River (2-27) is marked SEASONAL, and the rates page sells the riverbank row only as 'Seasonal Waterfront'; all nightly sites (blue W/E/S, red W/E) sit in the inland loops, the nearest (144-146) behind the pet area above the day-use beach. Esri World Imagery frames read 2026-10-21 (rendered: 440 m at 43.2675,-89.7200; 200 m at 43.26838,-89.71880; 260 m at 43.26700,-89.71830): the riverbank pads are a single row of seasonal units; the north end is a day-use beach with a volleyball court and lawn, fronted by a tree band along the top of the beach, and the inland loops are 70+ m from the water across that used strip and screened by it. River is the tailwater below the Prairie du Sac dam, so no lake/dam issue. No nightly RV site on or in view of the water -> not waterfront (default down)
fees_source: https://www.buddysriverresort.com/campsite-options read 2026-10-21 (identical in Wayback capture 2026-06-10): RV site (water/electric 30 or 50A, sewer site-dependent) WEEKDAY $50, WEEKEND $65 (2-night minimum), HOLIDAY $75 (3-night minimum), for 2 adults + up to 4 children or 4 adults; extras only for additional people ($10), vehicles ($5) or a boat ($5); no per-night resort fee. Tax not stated. The $40/$50/$60 tier on the same page is the tent site

booking.note: Weekdays sell single nights at the weekday rate; 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holidays

flags: Weekday RV rate $50, weekend $65 (2026 season); in only because the price gate is lifted.

Online booking link (book.rvspots.com/Buddy'sRiverResort) returns 404 now (park closed until May 1 2027; reservations open Feb 1 2027); nights are sold by phone at posted rates. Recheck the engine in February.
Nightly share ~42% by the operator map (63 of ~150 sites); the river row is seasonal only.
Weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums only; weekdays sell a single night.
Policies: must be 21+ to register; one pet per site (two max), restricted-breed list.
Pin is on the inland RV loops; the operator map is schematic, so it is not pinned to a specific nightly site.
